name: CrownLand - Default (seed v1)
description: Kingdom-held land such as a frontier fort or a royal forest: a region and a range, owned by a kingdom. Crown land outranks town territory where they overlap (territory V1, #326, G10).

steps.description: Name the crown land and pick the kingdom that holds it.

fields.label: Name
fields.description: Shown on the map and in the web app.

fields.label: Description
fields.description: A line or two for admins, e.g. "Royal forest north of Phoenix".

fields.label: Kingdom
fields.description: The kingdom that holds this land.

fields.label: Range (blocks)
fields.description: How far from the nearest edge of the region the crown land reaches, 0 to 10000. 0 = the region only. No capital multiplier applies.

steps.description: The WorldGuard region that anchors the crown land. Use Send to Minecraft and select the area in game with WorldEdit, or type the name of an existing region.

fields.label: Region
fields.description: The anchor region. A region drawn here is renamed domain_<id> when the crown land is saved; it has no parent region.

fields.label: Allow entry
fields.description: Players may walk into the anchor region.

fields.label: Allow exit
fields.description: Players inside the anchor region may walk out of it.
